# Michael Tupas Cardose

> Full-stack & mobile developer in Bataan, Philippines. React / TypeScript front ends, a React Native app, and PHP / Node / Cloudflare Workers back ends over MySQL and D1.

Currently a Software Engineer at the Maritime Academy of Asia and the Pacific (MAAP), owning the Online Admission System end to end. Sole engineer on Kosher Kav (React Native + Cloudflare Workers) and GlowSimcha (PHP 8.2 API + React 19, Stripe Connect).

## Case studies

- [Online Admission System (OMAS)](https://michael-cardose.vercel.app/work/omas-admission-system): React 18 + TS SPA over a layered PHP JSON API; 5,000+ live registrations.
- [Kosher Kav](https://michael-cardose.vercel.app/work/kosher-kav): React Native app + Next.js 16 admin on Cloudflare Workers / D1 / Durable Objects; 1,347 tests.
- [GlowSimcha](https://michael-cardose.vercel.app/work/glowsimcha): Two-sided booking marketplace; 87 REST endpoints, Stripe Connect, self-hosted WebSockets, MySQL SPATIAL.
- [Public Health Information System](https://michael-cardose.vercel.app/work/public-health-is): Laravel 12 + React 19 with z-score outbreak detection; ~900 tests.
